<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Margaret Thomas on 10/01/2025 09:26 ---------------------------


"Renault, Susan" <susan.renault@velzengroup.edu> on 24/12/2024 10:59:38
To: "aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>
cc: "margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr" <margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr> 
Subject: RE: Saint-Hilaire Clinic


Dear Aimé / Margaret,

Thank you for visiting Montclair to present the clinical initiatives. It was a pleasure meeting your team and we look forward to collaborating with Lumière Santé. Please also extend our gratitude for the dinner.

We wanted to update you on our research and gather feedback before our upcoming visit to Saint-Hilaire Clinic on 17 January. Our study will focus on the third approach you outlined. We aim to address part of the Health Services division’s operations. We are considering two paths: (i) analyzing patient intake procedures and recommending improvements for outpatient care, or (ii) reviewing the medical supply chain and advising on potential investment areas.

However, we need additional details on the Outpatient Care Services before finalizing the scope. We welcome any suggestions, especially if you envision a broader or different focus; please let us know.

We have yet to review the initial documents sent last week, but here are some questions specifically about the Health Services unit:

Could we access the overall business plan or a more detailed summary than the annual report? What is the pricing strategy and general framework? Who are the patients and how are they engaged? What alternatives do patients have if not using Lumière Santé? What are the plans and capabilities for international expansion? Is there any key regulatory information available?

If this is not already included in the materials you provided, could you recommend other sources for this information?

Once we review the documents, we may want to arrange a call with you or a colleague directly involved in Health Services. I will reach out in the new year to discuss further. Meanwhile, feel free to contact me at +33 4 59 27 70 77 if you need anything.

Regards,
Outpatient Care Services Rapid Response Team
Ram
Dennis
Jason
Omar
Steve
Clay
